title: task
description:
Add optimizePackageImports to next.config.ts for lucide-react barrel imports.

title: BP-010: Stable keyboard handler ref
description:
Use ref for keyboard handler to avoid rebinding event listener on every render.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Update ref.current with handler logic
- [ ] Effect uses stable wrapper that calls ref.current
- [ ] Remove togglePreview, handleQuickExport from effect deps
- [ ] pnpm build passes
- [ ] Verify keyboard shortcuts still work

## Files
- src/app/page.tsx

## Impact
MEDIUM - Cleaner effect dependencies, fewer listener rebinds
